points.description: States that a C++ program begins executing at the main function (main()). Equivalent wording such as 'the main() function' or 'the function named main' earns the mark. Naming any other function as the starting point earns no marks.

rubric.notes: The model answer is a single idea, so one all-or-nothing point carries the full 5 marks. Full marks for naming main (or main()) as the place where execution begins, in any equivalent wording. No marks if the student names another function, a line of code, or gives no answer.
